country_decisions: Each programme's eligibility and amount as an approved rule (social.<programme>, lib/law/rules.ts; none ships), its evidence, payment periods and appeal route (the nation's law).

library.title: Review a benefit for suspension or termination
library.intro: A review of whether a benefit should be suspended or terminated, on stated facts and evidence, after notice and the person's representations. A score can never cut support; two officials decide with an explanation and the review route.
library.filled_by: An official of the social protection authority, signed in.
library.authority: The social protection authority the nation names for the socialProtection slot (authorityFor('socialProtection'), shipped empty). Never a ministry by name.

policies.access.read_rule: canReadSocial() in lib/auth/roles.ts: the social protection authority's officials with a stated purpose; every read in the access log
policies.access.others: No other institution reads these records; payments leave only as instructions to the payment service

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
No field scores a person, a household, a credential, an employer or an application: no risk, credibility, propensity or match score exists in the contract or its procedure
deviations.why: Directions §15.6 and §15.7; supplement Part 15: a risk score alone cannot determine loss of essential support; field series Part 4 §4.4: no opaque risk scores.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Immigration and Customs ("never a score"); lib/social/procedures.ts refuses a suspension whose grounds rest on a score

deviations.what: The social protection authority is the institution the nation names for the socialProtection slot, shipped empty; until it is named no case opens
deviations.why: Specification Part 2 §A.7: each benefit requires its own approved eligibility rules, under the body the law names.

quotes: Owns: claims, eligibility evidence, decisions, payment instructions, reassessments and appeals.
Each benefit requires its own approved eligibility rules.

platform.how: Claims with every assessment and its approved rule version; decisions, payment instructions, reassessments and appeals; each programme its own approved rule (social.<programme>)

quotes: The schema deliberately makes some fields conditional.
A universal form that collects all household, health, financial and identity information for every programme would be excessive.
Each programme should request only the evidence its lawful eligibility rules require.

platform.how: Inputs only as the programme's rule requires: income, assets and deductions by line, each with its source; no universal household, health, financial and identity form

quotes: Benefits cannot be denied solely because an external database is unavailable.

platform.how: An identity check that cannot be made holds the claim; refusal is not open from the held stage (acceptance P2-08)

quotes: A mismatch is a discrepancy to resolve, not proof of fraud.

platform.how: Each input line records whether it was verified; a mismatch is resolved by the officer, never scored

quotes: Automated calculations must show the rule version and inputs used.

platform.how: Each assessment keeps its inputs, means, rule key, version and digest and the calculation steps; reproduceAssessment() re-runs them (P2-07)

quotes: Affected people must receive an understandable explanation of the decision, subject to applicable law.

platform.how: Award, refusal and variation require an explanation to the person

quotes: Reassessment and correction must not erase the earlier decision or its evidence.

platform.how: A reassessment adds a version; earlier assessments, decisions and evidence are kept

quotes: Appeals must be assigned to a role with appropriate independence from the original decision.

platform.how: social.appeal refuses a reviewer who took part in the decision appealed

quotes: No universal government-wide “risk score” for a person or household.
Mandatory safeguards: sensitive social-service records must be purpose-limited and segregated by role.
Benefit eligibility and payment decisions must be explainable, linked to the applicable rule version, reviewable by an authorized human, and appealable where the law provides.
A risk score alone cannot determine loss of essential support.

platform.how: Restricted cases, read by the social protection authority with a purpose; decisions linked to the rule version, by two officials, with the review route; a suspension whose grounds rest on a score is refused

label.en: The facts the review rests on, with their evidence

en.required: Enter the facts the review rests on, with their evidence.

label.en: Evidence of the facts relied on
